title: CAS-07246 — RTÉ News: Nine O’Clock and Weather — RTÉ One
text:
Programme: RTÉ News: Nine O’Clock and Weather
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ One
Date broadcast or accessed: 28.01.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Section 46L(1)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended. Code of Fairness, Objectivity & Impartiality in News and Current Affairs: Obligations 12.2.1, 12.2.2 & 12.2.3.
Short description: The complaint is about a news report covering tensions between Iran and the Unites States. The complaint alleges the report was not impartial and broadcast the partisan position of the US Government, and of the broadcaster itself.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
